title: Veggie Macaroni Salad with Smoky Tempeh, Lettuce & Bread Crumbs

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice tempeh.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh, soy sauce, smoked paprika, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes. Remove tempeh to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl and set aside.

Return the skillet to medium heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bread crumbs and toast, stirring often, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add garlic powder and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine the macaroni salad.
Separate lettuce into leaves and arrange on plates. Top with macaroni salad, bread crumbs, and tempeh. Enjoy!
